about: An attorney at Ruiz Law Firm, PLLC, located in Pearland, Texas, Adalberto Ruiz focuses his practice on immigration matters, criminal defense and personal injury. Some of the cases he takes on include but is not limited to the following:

A dedicated attorney with a genuine concern for his clients, Mr. Ruiz is a zealous advocate for their rights and liberties. During this difficult and confusing time in his clients’ lives, Mr. Ruiz ensures that he is accessible and responsive from the inception of the case till its end. He is well known for the compassionate yet tenacious legal counsel he provides.

Mr. Ruiz has a Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of the District of Columbia with a major in mass media art. He obtained his Juris Doctor from the Texas Southern University Thurgood Marshall School of Law, along with a mediation certification honor.

Mr. Ruiz has immense experience helping immigrant families and youths with U.S. citizenship matters, and with applying for the DACA program with the USCIS and the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. For his remarkable contribution and legal services in the state of Texas, Mr. Ruiz has a “Very Good” rating on Avvo, accompanied by numerous testimonials from satisfied clients and endorsements and referrals from peers.

Actively committed to the legal community, Mr. Ruiz has memberships in the State Bar of Texas, the Hispanic National Bar Association, the Mexican American Bar Association and the Texas Young Lawyers Association. He is also a member of the American Immigration Lawyers Association.
